description: Defines an interface class 'resource_grid_reader' for reading resource grid data in a wireless communication system, including methods for checking emptiness, retrieving resource elements with various options, and viewing resource data.

classes.name: resource_grid_reader
classes.description: Interface class for reading resource grid data, inheriting from resource_grid_base, providing methods to query and access resource elements.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is empty, i.e., no data has been written since last zero set.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the entire resource grid is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves resource elements at a specific port and symbol, filtered by a bitmask.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves resource elements at a specific port and symbol, filtered by a bitmask, for complex float16 types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves resource elements at a specific port and symbol, starting at a given subcarrier index, with a stride.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a consecutive block of resource elements at a specific port and symbol.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Provides a read-only view of all resource elements for a given port and symbol.
